title: NPSP Baby Boot Camp
intro: A hands-on workshop to assist you in caring for your new baby!

sections.markdown:
* Discuss infant development and the importance of bonding with your baby
* Learn about the first few months of your baby's life and the fulfillment of being a parent
* Learn how to enjoy, nurture, and provide positive parenting which is important for infant development
* Learn how to prepare the nursery, diaper, feed, bathe, and dress your baby
* Learn ways to communicate with your baby, how to calm a fussy baby, and when to call the doctor
* Learn safe sleep practices for the baby
* Focus on what to expect when you bring your baby home
* **Recommended for the 3rd trimester**

**Dress code is civilian attire.** Feel free to bring snacks and drinks.

**Registration is required.** [Register on Eventbrite to save your spot!](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/mccs-quantico-new-parent-support-program-npsp-42943967143)

Location: NPSP, Little Hall, Lower Level

For more information, call 703.784.4248 or email, [MCCSQuanticoNPSP@usmc.mil](mailto:MCCSQuanticoNPSP@usmc.mil)
